resource: Encoded QuestLineV1 (one quest line or tracked quest of domain 16)
allocation_impact: Measured 13,057 for the worst case of the largest quest (Killing in the Name Of, every mission visible with its longest text). The catalogue computes each quest's worst case at load and refuses a catalogue over the bound, so a projected line always fits; the encoder refuses one byte more.
boundary_tests: max=16384: a line of exactly 16,384 bytes encodes and decodes
max+1=16385: one more text byte is refused before any byte is emitted
notes: QUEST-GATE-0 §9 (QUESTGATE0-RL-08 payload bytes). Measured over content/quests/definitions (58 storyline quests with missions, 529 missions) from each mission's name and the longest journal text reference length, a template counted with 20 bytes per placeholder.
